description: 200 brilliant JS and web people gathering in Shoreditch for a day that's actually worth your time. Local London talent plus presenters from around the world, zero sales nonsense, proper food and drinks, and an afterparty featuring our notorious JS Pub Quiz and karaoke.
faqs: Does HalfStack London have last minute tickets available?
Not always. We love our venue but we're constrained by its size. Get your ticket early to save and avoid disappointment!
schedule: HalfStack starts around 10am, includes approximately 10 sessions, breaks, lunch, dinner, and the JS Pub Quiz afterparty. Plan to arrive between 9:00-9:45am and stay late! We have announced our first few presenters, with more to be revealed soon.
